title: Server-side input validation
asvsRequirement: Input validation is enforced at a trusted service layer and client validation is not treated as a security control.

title: HttpOnly session cookie
asvsRequirement: Session cookies that scripts do not need use HttpOnly and are delivered only through Set-Cookie.

title: Authentication assertion signatures
asvsRequirement: Authentication assertions are rejected when unsigned or signed with an invalid signature.

title: Trusted session verification
asvsRequirement: All session-token verification is performed by a trusted backend service.

title: Object-level authorization
asvsRequirement: Data-specific access is limited to explicitly permitted items to mitigate IDOR and BOLA.

title: Secrets management
asvsRequirement: Backend secrets are managed outside source and build artifacts by a secrets-management solution.

title: Production debug disabled
asvsRequirement: Debug modes are disabled for all production components.

title: Generic error responses
asvsRequirement: Unexpected or security-sensitive errors return generic messages without sensitive internal data.
